1.t: Has the news of the Overwhelming Event reached you ˹O Prophet˺

2.t: On that Day ˹some˺ faces will be downcast

5.t: left to drink from a scalding spring

6.t: They will have no food except a foul, thorny shrub
6.tr: Laisa lahum ta'aamun illaa min daree'

7.tr: Laa yusminu Wa-laa yughnee min joo'

8.t: On that Day ˹other˺ faces will be glowing with bliss

11.t: where no idle talk will be heard

12.t: In it will be a running spring

17.t: Do they not ever reflect on camels—how they were ˹masterfully˺ created
17.tr: Afalaa yanzuroona ilal ibili kaifa khuliqat

18.t: and the sky—how it was raised ˹high˺

19.t: and the mountains—how they were firmly set up

20.t: and the earth—how it was levelled out

21.t: So, ˹continue to˺ remind ˹all, O Prophet˺, for your duty is only to remind

22.t: You are not ˹there˺ to compel them ˹to believe˺

23.t: But whoever turns away, persisting in disbelief

24.t: then Allah will inflict upon them the major punishment

25.t: Surely to Us is their return

26.t: then surely with Us is their reckoning
